notes: retrieval: on-topic for SQLite but the dedicated FTS5 page was never surfaced; the answer never defines FTS5 itself
extraction: infobox fragments ('Filename extension .sqlite, .sqlite3…') and reference markers [ 30 ] [ 31 ] in prose

notes: retrieval: Roger Waters concert page retrieved on the shared title; both factual pages correct
extraction: BUG — third template-JSON leak ('"},"location":{"wt":"[[East Berlin]]…')
the direct answer passage ('The Berlin Wall fell on 9 November 1989…') was present and cited

findings: F1 (bug, highest priority): wikitext/template JSON leaks into stored passages on 3 of 8 real pages (cases 03, 05, 08) — htmlToText + block-heuristic extraction do not handle MediaWiki template metadata embedded in REST HTML. Fix direction: prefer the MediaWiki plain-text extract endpoint (action=query&prop=extracts&explaintext) for page content instead of stripping HTML; tracked as the suggested follow-up task (SRC-07).
F2 (noise): reference markers ('[ 30 ]') and infobox fragments routinely survive as passages — the extraction-cleanliness mean is 0.31 over real-world pages vs a synthetic corpus designed clean.

F3 (retrieval): ambiguous terms surface entity-doppelgangers (singer/state/concert/BLP) in 5 of 8 cases; relevance mean 0.56. BM25-only retrieval; the RET-02 hybrid path may help and should be re-measured on real data after F1 lands.
F4 (posture observation): a health question surfaced critic biographies alongside the mechanism article; Wikipedia NPOV kept the stored text factual — recorded for future abuse/misinfo QUAL work.
F5 (clean): no instruction-shaped (prompt-injection) content observed in any captured passage; R-12 stays open for the live-model future.

F6 (limits): citation-resolution and degradation-honesty are 1.0 under the FIXTURE model, which composes blocks from stored evidence — these numbers measure the harness, not a model (docs/quality-gate.md limits).
limits: Single-annotator authorial labels over one operator's run; not model quality; no quality claim may cite this artifact without docs/quality-gate.md's limits (R-06).
